question: Would Saigon Co.op's private-label team list a higher-protein (10 g or more per 100 g) version of an existing Co.op Select chay dumpling or roll made by GN Foods, and at what shelf price, margin and minimum volume?
why_it_matters: Decides whether retailer private label is a first route to shelf for TPP-02 without building a consumer brand; today's Co.op Select chay line is starch and vegetable led
cheapest_way_to_close: Submit one product pitch with GN Foods through Co.op's supplier portal (answer within 10 working days) and hold one interview with the private-label team
owner_org_to_ask: Saigon Co.op private-label department; GN Foods JSC

question: What protein content do the dry soy-gluten chay pieces sold to kitchens (Panko suon mieng chay, An Nhien foodservice packs) have, and how much do caterers and school kitchens buy?
why_it_matters: Sets the real price to beat for TPP-04 (about VND 4,000 to 5,100 per 20 g protein on a borrowed protein range) and shows whether canteens already use plant protein
cheapest_way_to_close: Buy five foodservice packs and read the labels; ask Kamereo and MM Mega Market for category sales to caterers and schools
owner_org_to_ask: Kamereo; Sumimoto (Panko); MM Mega Market; AltProtein Vietnam team

question: Why is CP Meat Zero no longer orderable on Kamereo, and was it sold through C.P. shops or retail in Vietnam?
why_it_matters: Separates a failed B2B test from a supply pause; tells investors whether an integrated meat group's own analogue failed in Vietnamese foodservice
owner_org_to_ask: C.P. Vietnam marketing; Kamereo category team

question: How are Accor's Vietnamese hotels delivering the 50% vegetarian or plant-based dish target (2030) and Novotel's 25% (2026): current share, protein sources and suppliers?
why_it_matters: The only corporate commitment that binds Vietnamese units; would name a showcase buyer and show whether the dish metric creates any protein-ingredient demand
cheapest_way_to_close: Request Accor's Vietnam reporting; audit the menus of ten Accor hotels in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Da Nang and Nha Trang
owner_org_to_ask: Accor Vietnam; Humane World for Animals Viet Nam (Forward Food)

question: What does ACC charge for Angel Yeast's yeast protein in Vietnam, and which makers have sampled or trialled it since May 2025?
why_it_matters: Sets the competitor price for TPP-06 and TPP-05 and could replace the ch26.6 clean negative on novel-protein pilots
cheapest_way_to_close: One call to ACC's food and nutrition team (overlaps AIS-L10)

question: Will WinCommerce's 25 to 50 planned house brands include frozen chay or tofu, and who would make them?
why_it_matters: WinCommerce reaches about 6,100 stores by end 2026; a house-brand chay line would be the largest private-label route
cheapest_way_to_close: One interview; check the online assortment of three more stores

question: Does MM Mega Market sell dry textured soy, gluten or foodservice chay packs to kitchens, and at what price per kg?
why_it_matters: MM is a cash-and-carry used by kitchens; its prices were not retrievable online
cheapest_way_to_close: One store visit in Ho Chi Minh City

question: Does Bach Hoa Xanh sell private-label chay or tofu?
why_it_matters: Completes the private-label map for the largest minimart chain

question: Which Vietnamese food companies hold cage-free pledges, and do the same staff decide protein sourcing?
why_it_matters: Tests whether a protein ask could ride on existing welfare engagement (AFN-Q23); VAWW publishes no list
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam Animal Welfare Watch; Humane World for Animals Viet Nam
